name: Stanford Medical Youth Science Program (SMYSP)
what_you_do: You can join a five-week, tuition-free summer program on Stanford's campus to explore medicine. It is for current juniors from low-income and first-generation backgrounds.
who_can_apply: Current high school juniors who are low-income and first-generation college students living in Northern California. About 24 students are admitted.
pay_detail: Tuition free. Housing and stipend not stated.
deadline_text: The 2027 application opens Nov 15, 2026. No closing date is posted. The 2027 session runs June 21 to July 23, 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply online through the SlideRoom link on the SMYSP page when it opens on Nov 15, 2026. Contact: smysp-team@stanford.edu.
notes: The page gives 2027 session dates of June 21 to July 23, 2027. It says the 2027 application opens Nov 15, 2026. It does not say if housing or a stipend is given.
